metadata.title: Disco Era Portrait with Flourished Serif Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A centered glamour portrait featuring high-volume dark hair against a solid teal backdrop with elegant, flourished serif typography in the upper right corner.

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up portrait of a woman with extremely voluminous, dark curly hair that fills much of the frame. She wears a white lace or embroidered garment. The background is a flat, slightly textured teal-blue. Typography is positioned in the top right, featuring high-contrast serifs with decorative swashes.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's dark hair contrasts sharply against the teal background
The white lace garment provides a bright anchor at the bottom
Typography is tucked into the negative space created by the hair's silhouette
Soft, directional lighting emphasizes facial contours and hair texture
coreInvariants: High-volume, expansive dark curly hair silhouette
Solid teal or cyan-blue background color

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered bust-up portrait; hair occupies approximately 60% of the horizontal width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, specifically the eyes and lips, framed by the dark hair.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the face, outward to the expansive hair, then up to the flourished typography in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Teal background visible primarily in the upper corners and around the hair's outer edges.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted background saturation with high value contrast between the dark hair and white lace.

letterConstructionRules: Extreme stroke contrast between thick and thin lines
Extended swashes on capital letters (D, S)
Tightly tracked lowercase with italicized lean for subtitles
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital 'D' and 'S' feature circular flourished terminals
The 'S' swash underlines the subsequent letters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Large flourished display serif paired with a smaller, slanted serif subtitle.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 70s decorative serif aesthetic perfectly.
Provides the necessary high contrast and elegant curves.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a woman with massive, voluminous dark curly hair wearing a white lace top against a solid teal background, leaving the top right corner clear.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add high-contrast serif text in the top right corner using black ink, incorporating decorative swashes on the initial capital letters.

verificationChecks: Is the hair silhouette expansive and curly?
Is the background a solid teal color?
Is the text aligned to the top right?
Do the capital letters have decorative swashes?

mustRedesign: Do not use flat sans-serif fonts
Ensure hair texture is detailed and not a solid block
postGenerationChecks: Ensure hair volume dominates the frame
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Voluminous Hair + Teal Backdrop + Swash Serif Typography
